name: PA-04
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Madeleine Dean running with a large cash advantage
No polls or expert ratings available
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Dean: a D+8 district, incumbency, and a roughly $1.2 million cash edge over a first-time challenger with no visible fundraising. Markets price her around 95%, consistent with a Safe D rating.
model.watch: A late surge of outside spending for Stuski or a sharply unfavorable national environment could narrow the margin.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Madeleine Dean seeks another term in a suburban Philadelphia district that leans Democratic by about eight points. She enters the race with a clear financial advantage, having raised roughly $1.4 million and holding about $1.2 million on hand, while Republican challenger Aurora Stuski has shown little reported fundraising or outside support. No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, so expectations rest on district fundamentals and money.

Prediction markets give Dean roughly a 95% chance of winning, in line with the seat's partisan lean and incumbency. The forecast expects a comfortable Dean victory, with uncertainty reflecting the absence of polling rather than any sign of a competitive race.
